title: Black Light Propulsion & Transit Authority Manifest
purpose: Machine-readable discoverability bridge for the propulsion/transit authority chain. This manifest repairs the stale human-readable source index without changing authority order or promoting subordinate documents above BLACK_LIGHT_PROPULSION_TRANSIT_AUTHORITY.md.

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Design intent for family-specific gravity/miscalculation penalties, shear-lane hazards, safety lookahead, emergency de-transit, maturity-scaled redundancy, realistic mathematics, and generations-deep educational/technical documentation.

authorityOrder: specific named race/species, organization, manufacturer, vessel, installation, and named technology sources
recovered FTL archive definitions and current explicit operator physics
EXO operative-technology and vessel-design governing sources
current runtime behavior within implementation scope
integrationRules: This manifest indexes authority; it does not reorder it.
A missing entry in this manifest does not demote a higher-authority named source.
The primary authority remains the human-readable integration entrypoint until explicitly superseded.
Generator/runtime code may use this manifest for discoverability but must still obey field-level provenance/status.
DERIVED and PROPOSED documents remain subordinate even when listed here.
Race/vessel-specific material outranks generic embodiment only within its documented scope.
Current runtime behavior is authoritative for implementation behavior, not automatically for setting-wide historical canon.
Calibration profile identity and version must be retained by any numerical safety certificate that depends on it.
Generated capability and route safety certification are separate outputs; REJECTED, UNRESOLVED, and CONFLICT states may not be flattened into ordinary certified performance.
The live EXO FTL certification UI must preserve the generated family when the family selector is random and must embed the route-safety certificate in exported dossiers.
The live EXO FTL route selector must visibly retain certification state for every evaluated route and guard blocked alternatives without erasing the failed selected route needed for diagnosis.

The safety-envelope presentation must expose gravity retention, calculation retention, actionable lookahead, recovery reserve, and hazard observability as separate constraints rather than averaging them into a synthetic safety percentage.
repairNote: The primary authority's embedded source index predates several measurement, evidence, archaeology, forensic, runtime, Mur'rek, safety-certification, calibration, route-safety, live route-certification, and selector-envelope additions. This manifest provides a complete current machine-readable chain without rewriting or silently superseding the primary authority. A future targeted human-readable index edit should mirror this manifest.
